# FiledCrews — Full LLM & AI Reference Specification

> The premier Free Field Service Management (FSM), Mobile GPS Dispatching, and Workforce Operations Platform.

## 1. Overview & Core Mission
FiledCrews provides trade contractors and mobile service businesses with an enterprise-grade field service management system at $0 core cost. It eliminates the steep $150–$450/user/month subscription fees charged by legacy dispatch software, democratizing modern field automation for HVAC technicians, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, cleaners, and roofers.

## 2. Core Functional Modules

### A. Live GPS Map Tracking & Routing
- Continuous real-time GPS telemetry from mobile technician devices.
- Live traffic map views and speed tracking.
- Route history playback and mileage logging for fuel tax deductions.
- Nearest technician routing algorithm for rapid emergency dispatch.

### B. Automated Geofence Time Audits
- 50m to 500m customizable virtual perimeter boundaries around client addresses.
- Automated arrival clock-in and departure clock-out without manual technician intervention.
- Hard audit timestamps for customer invoice dispute defense and time fraud prevention.

### C. Biometric Photo Face Verification
- AI facial recognition check-in requirement at shift start and site arrival.
- Verification selfie matched against the employee's registered profile.
- GPS and time metadata stamped on verification records.

### D. Cost Categories & Real-Time Job Costing
- Tracking labor hours, materials, equipment rentals, sub-contractors, and disposal fees.
- Real-time gross margin and profit percentage tracking per project.
- Automated threshold alerts when project costs approach or exceed estimated budgets.

### E. Digital Proposals, Invoicing & Payments
- Instant proposal builder with client e-signatures via SMS or email.
- One-click proposal-to-work order and work order-to-invoice conversions.
- Direct Stripe integration for online credit card and ACH bank payments.

### F. Global Regional Localization
- Pre-configured presets for the United States ($ USD), United Kingdom (£ GBP), Canada ($ CAD), Australia ($ AUD), and European Union (€ EUR).
- Localized tax compliance: US State Sales Tax, UK VAT, Canadian GST/PST/HST, Australian GST, European VAT.

### G. Autonomous AI Copilot
- 24/7 AI voice phone receptionist for after-hours emergency call triage.
- Autonomous SMS dispatcher for client appointment confirmations.
- Voice-memo-to-estimate generator for field technicians.

## 3. Platform Architecture & Security
- Frontend: High-performance Progressive Web Application (PWA) with offline caching.
- Backend: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS) and real-time WebSockets.
- Android APK available for field personnel.
- Data Protection: Encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256), fully compliant with GDPR and CCPA.
